answer.reason: Two events belong to Mesopotamia in the story: God's appearing to Abraham there, and its king's defeat by Othniel.

clauses.english: was where the God of glory appeared to Abraham before Charran
clauses.quote: The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia

clauses.english: had its king Chushanrishathaim delivered by the LORD into Othniel's hand
clauses.quote: the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand

doubts: NUM 23:7 (Aram), DEU 23:4 (Balaam of Pethor), 1CH 19:6 (hired chariots), PSA 60:1 (Aram-naharaim), HOS 12:12 (Syria) and ACT 2:9 (dwellers present at Pentecost) were left out as minor or not clearly this region.
